none: PAS CAM-CF2808: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy Dupondius of Vespasian, (AD 69-79) (Reece period 4)
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ FORTVNAE REDVCI, S C ; D/ IMP CAES VESPASIAN AVG COS IIII

A copper-alloy Dupondius of Vespasian, (AD 69-79) (Reece period 4). Reverse legend reads FORTVNAE REDVCI, S C. Reverse shows Fortuna standing left, holding branch and rudder on globe and cornucopiae. Mint is Lugdunum (Lyon, France). See RIC II, pt. 1, p. 144, no. 1187. Obverse legend reads IMP CAES VESPASIAN AVG COS IIII. Obverse shows Radiate head right. Die axis is 6 o'clock. Weight is 12.87,…
